opening.argument: The presentation actively promotes paid participation through a binary marketing and network-business structure, not merely discussing cryptocurrency. It states, “we have marketing for OneCoin companies of course, and the marketing is binary” and describes matching payments, while also tying membership registration to obtaining a referral: “You can get a referral you just need to sign up and register a membership to Binari.” Paid packages are presented as routes to substantial projected returns: the €5,000 Tycoon package “can give more than 31 thousand Euro in a short-term perspective,” with the displayed presentation figures showing token doubling and profits of €31,000 to €45,000. Mining is also framed as “a longer-term investment.” The speaker then provides a registration link and urges viewers to “Take positions in Binaria” and test the opportunity, encouraging early participation rather than offering neutral analysis.
